name: Satori
description: A Claude skill blending psychology, philosophy, and wisdom traditions into a conversation partner with actual depth. Free, open-source, not a therapist.
longDescription: Satori is a universal multi-agent wisdom companion built on global wisdom traditions (Stoicism, Taoism, Buddhism, Sufi wisdom, Hindu philosophy, Confucian ethics, Ubuntu/Akan/Kemetic African philosophy, Haudenosaunee/Cree/Potawatomi Indigenous thought) and modern clinical psychology (IFS, DBT, CFT, Schema Therapy, ACT, Somatic, Dual Process Grief, Relational Psychoanalysis). Calibrated across 16 environments (10 agent harnesses and 6 web chat surfaces) and 5 behavioral model profiles with progressive disclosure, a privacy-first local memory vault, and a two-stage anti-gaming evaluation suite.

installMethods.label: Claude.ai Skill Upload
installMethods.description: Build or download SatoriSkill-v6.5.2.zip and upload in Claude.ai Customize -> Skills
steps: Open claude.ai and click Customize in the left sidebar
Click Skills, then the + button, then Upload a skill

installMethods.label: Google Antigravity / Gemini CLI
steps: Clone the repository or copy `.agents/skills/satori` to `~/.gemini/skills/satori`

installMethods.label: Claude Code Plugin
installMethods.description: Install via Claude Code plugin system using .claude-plugin/plugin.json
